goal: Shrink non-GUI Linux release binaries by stripping unused standard library components in Guix builds
Users download smaller static binaries for non-GUI tools like bitcoind and bitcoin-cli
agreement: Approach approval because the base compiler package is reused in the GUI build stage (hebasto)
Unaddressed suggestion: check potential side effects of Boost wchar macros on Boost.MultiIndex (hebasto)
